lines.text: Many learners say: I have many homeworks today.
Better: I have a lot of homework today.
Homework has no s. Say a lot of.
Homework! I have a lot of homework.

data.right: I have a lot of homework today.
data.why: Homework has no s. Say a lot of.

native.tip: homework 是不可数名词，不加 s，也不能用 many。

en.tip: Homework is uncountable, so no s and no many. Say “a lot of”.
en.caption: Do you say “I have many homeworks today.”? 😅 Homework is uncountable, so no s and no many: “I have a lot of homework today.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
